title: Feathered Local Royalty
description: Stumbling upon majestic peacocks showing off their vibrant plumage near historic stone courtyards.
altText: Two peacocks displaying their full, colorful tail feathers on a stone patio alongside a rustic stone wall.

title: Rooftop Feathers & Sunshine
description: Local peacocks perching high above the streets, effortlessly soaking up the sunny Lisbon vibes.
altText: Three peacocks perched atop a high metal fence in front of a yellow and white Portuguese building under a clear blue sky.

title: Alfresco Sundowner Sipping
description: Unwinding at a cosy pavement café with cold beers and warm afternoon sunshine.
altText: Two glasses of beer on a chequered tablecloth at an outdoor café table, with a potted green plant and patio dining in the background.

title: Fresh Local Feast
description: Indulging in simple, delicious grilled sardines and boiled potatoes for an authentic taste of Portugal.
altText: Plate of grilled sardines served with boiled potatoes and a side salad on a restaurant table.
